title: Output Aggregation Parameter
description: Canonical per-column output-aggregation parameter under the identity model. Replaces the legacy rate_type token system with a (period, aggregation) tuple plus an optional threshold. Mirrors output_param_schema in libs-server/validators.mjs.

output_threshold.description: Predicate applied to the aggregated per-period total. Required by, and only valid with, aggregation 'count'.

op.description: Comparison operator applied to the per-period measure total

value.description: Right-hand operand of the threshold comparison

output_parameter.description: Parameterizes how a numeric measure column aggregates to rows. Absence of the parameter means aggregation 'sum' with no period, which is the default and bypasses the aggregator registry entirely.

period.description: Denominator or counting grain. Valid values are enumerated in ./../values/output-periods.json and must resolve to a registered (period, aggregation) tuple.

aggregation.description: Measure shape. Enumerated with semantics in ./../values/output-aggregations.json.

allOf.description: count requires a threshold (validator error outputCountRequiresThreshold)
threshold is rejected on any aggregation other than count (validator error outputThresholdRequiresCount)

legacy_alias.translation: normalize_output_param translates params.rate_type to params.output via translate_rate_type_to_output when params.output is absent

output_match_column_params.description: When true, the denominator CTE inherits the column's own play-filter params. Renamed from rate_type_match_column_params.

output_column_params.description: Explicit denominator play-filter params, used when output_match_column_params is false. Renamed from rate_type_column_params.

emission.rate: SUM(measure_total) / COUNT(period_key) against the materialized period CTE, joined on the identity-derived references
emission.count: COUNT(DISTINCT period_key) FILTER (WHERE measure_total <op> <value>) — the threshold applies to the aggregated per-period total, not to individual source rows

hundred_yard_games.note: New capability with no rate_type equivalent
